caption: The drawing consists of a large square design centered on a plain, off-white background. The square contains geometric patterns made up of bold lines and shapes. The colors used within the square are primarily shades of brown, black, gray, and red. Along the outermost edge of the square is a thick, uneven tan border with black circles and blocks distributed along the sides. Within this border is a secondary black line forming a smaller square inside, containing further shapes. Inside are sets of nested triangles and chevron shapes in red, gray, and black, arranged to create a sense of layering and symmetry. The center features a red diamond, bordered by gray and black lines, with intersecting diagonal and triangular shapes that extend outward. The design includes repeating triangular motifs, zigzag patterns at the top, and color-filled areas alternating between red, tan, and black.
title: End of Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
